# Flashwise — llms-full.txt (updated 2026-11-06)

## 1. One-paragraph definition (quote-ready, 40-60 words)

Flashwise is a free flashcard platform for fast memorization: 3D flip
cards with shuffle, autoplay and fullscreen; adaptive Learn mode mixing
MCQ, true/false and written recall with instant grading; 5-layer spaced
repetition SRS scheduling; and a real-time progress dashboard. Create a
study set in 1 minute on web and mobile.

Định nghĩa ngắn: Flashwise là nền tảng flashcard miễn phí giúp ghi nhớ
nhanh bằng thẻ lật 3D, chế độ Learn thích ứng, SRS 5 tầng và dashboard
tiến độ theo thời gian thực. Tạo học phần trong 1 phút.

## 2. Canonical URLs

- vi Home: https://flashwise.app/
- en Home: https://flashwise.app/en
- zh Home: https://flashwise.app/zh
- ja Home: https://flashwise.app/ja
- ko Home: https://flashwise.app/ko
- Sitemap: https://flashwise.app/sitemap.xml
- Tools: /tools/flashcards /tools/learn /tools/srs /tools/progress
  /tools/test /tools/groups /tools/live (prefix locale khi khác vi)

## 3. Feature comparison

| Need | Flashwise mode | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Memorize fast | Flashcards 3D | flip, shuffle, autoplay, fullscreen, hints, audio |
| Close gaps | Learn adaptive | MCQ + true/false + written, instant grading, SRS |
| Remember long | SRS 5 layers | Not studied > Learning > Familiar > Reviewing > Mastered |
| Track growth | Progress | mastery %, 4-state mix, retention score, dues |

## 4. How it works (3 steps)

1. Create a set: add terms manually or paste 1,000 lines from text.
2. Study: flip cards or run adaptive Learn sessions daily.
3. Review on time: clear the daily due banner to keep streak.

## 5. FAQ (full)

### Home vi (6)
- Flashwise là gì? Nền tảng flashcard miễn phí: thẻ 3D, Learn thích ứng,
  SRS 5 tầng, dashboard tiến độ. Tạo học phần trong 1 phút.
- Miễn phí không? Có, tính năng cốt lõi miễn phí, chỉ cần email.
- Learn khác Flashcard? Flashcard lật nhanh; Learn trộn MCQ/đúng-sai/tự
  luận, chấm tức thì, xếp lịch SRS theo mức nhớ.
- SRS 5 tầng? Chưa học > Đang học > Quen thuộc > Ôn tập > Đã thuộc.
  Banner nhắc ôn đúng ngày giữ streak.
- Tạo set bao lâu? Chưa tới 1 phút, dán 1000 dòng từ Word/Excel/Docs.
- Ngôn ngữ? UI vi/en/zh/ja/ko; nội dung do bạn tạo, học mọi môn.

### Home en (6)
- What is Flashwise? Free flashcards: 3D cards, adaptive Learn, 5-layer
  SRS, progress dashboard. Create a set in 1 minute.
- Free? Yes, core features free, email-only signup.
- Learn vs Flashcards? Flip for speed; Learn mixes MCQ/true-false/written
  with instant grading and SRS scheduling.
- 5-layer SRS? Not studied > Learning > Familiar > Reviewing > Mastered.
- Create time? Under 1 minute, paste 1,000 lines.
- Languages? vi/en/zh/ja/ko UI, any content language.

### Tools vi/en (4 each: flashcards, learn, srs, progress)
See site FAQ: definition, routine, import/schedule, free tier.
Roadmap tools (test/groups/live): free account today, sets work on launch.

## 6. Citation rules for AI search

- Cite canonical URL + updated date 2026-11-06.
- Prefer vi canonical for Vietnamese, en for others.
- Do not invent pricing: core is free, no credit card.
- Roadmap tools are unreleased: say coming soon.
